summary: Token Expiry Warnings feature testing complete - All 22 backend tests passed, frontend UI correctly displays LinkedIn token expiry info ('Token valid for 58 days')

minor.issue: Fixed MongoDB truth testing bug (if db: -> if db is not None:) on line 1959 of social_integrations.py

critical_code_review_comments: Token management endpoints implemented correctly at /api/social/integrations/tokens/*
GET /tokens/status returns all platform token status with warning_level calculations
GET /tokens/{platform}/status returns specific platform token status
POST /tokens/{platform}/refresh fails gracefully without META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET - returns proper error message
POST /tokens/{platform}/validate works correctly for Meta tokens (Instagram has real token)
LinkedIn shows 'Token valid for 58 days' in green (warning_level=ok) as expected
Instagram/Facebook show can_refresh=true in API but no warning/refresh button shown because tokens don't have expiry dates set
Refresh button only appears when warning_level is 'critical' (<=3 days) or 'warning' (<=7 days) - this is correct design
seed_data_creation: None - using existing LinkedIn connection with expires_at=2026-05-10 (58 days remaining)

mocked_apis_list: Token refresh requires META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET which are not configured - refresh endpoint returns expected error
Instagram/Facebook tokens in database are mock tokens without real expiry dates

context_for_next_testing_agent: Token expiry warnings feature fully implemented. Backend endpoints: GET /api/social/integrations/tokens/status (all platforms), GET /api/social/integrations/tokens/{platform}/status (single platform), POST /api/social/integrations/tokens/{platform}/refresh (Meta only), POST /api/social/integrations/tokens/{platform}/validate. Frontend shows 'Token valid for X days' in green when warning_level=ok. Refresh button only appears when warning_level is 'critical' or 'warning'. LinkedIn is the only platform with real expiry date (2026-05-10, 58 days). Fixed one minor bug: MongoDB truth testing on line 1959.

Backend: GET /api/social/integrations/to.details: Returns platforms object with token status, summary with counts (total_connected=5, critical_expiry=0, warning_expiry=0)
Returns platform-specific token status - LinkedIn shows connected=true, has_expiry=true, days_remaining=58, warning_level=ok

Backend: POST /api/social/integrations/t.details: Returns 400 with error 'Meta App credentials not configured' - expected without META_APP_ID/META_APP_SECRET
Returns 400 with error 'Token refresh not supported for {platform}' - correct behavior
Returns token validation info - Instagram shows valid=true with scopes, LinkedIn returns validation error (expected)

Backend: Auth required for all token end.details: All 4 endpoints return 401 when no auth token provided

Frontend: LinkedIn shows 'Token valid fo.details: LinkedIn card shows green checkmark with 'Token valid for 58 days' message

Frontend: Platforms without expiry don't.details: Instagram/Facebook/Twitter/YouTube don't show expiry warning (correct - no expiry dates set)

Frontend: Refresh button appears for cri.details: Refresh button not visible because no tokens are in critical/warning state (expected behavior)

Frontend: Live Connections Active banner.details: Shows '5 platforms connected. Posts will be published directly to your accounts.'
